yum_history
===========

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:yum_history``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``yum_history``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:yum_history``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * timestamp_path: ``hist_time``
   * artifact: ``yum_history``

Description
-----------

Package history from the yum/dnf log
